issue.description:
Bumping the `bead schema explain` field guide currently requires hand-coordinating schema.rs, the snapshot digests, and two literal digest pins in cli_schema.rs, and the digest-mismatch panic names only the snapshot file — so fixing the named file just yields a second panic on the next pin (observed repeatedly during the R010 comment field-guide bumps). Make the digest check report every stale location at once, and add a generator (or `bead` maintenance subcommand) that rewrites all pins from the rendered guide so a version bump cannot land half-updated. Test: a deliberately stale pin is reported at every stale location in a single failure.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Make field-guide snapshot bumps self-locating: report every stale digest pin in one pass
